title: OS command execution via exec (tcl) — review required
description: The tcl sink exec launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via exec with a fixed argv.
remediation: Use exec with a fixed argv with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any exec call matches.
